# Deployment hook for main and dev branches

GIT_REPO=/git/project.git
WORK_DIR=/tmp/git-work-$$
MAIN_DEPLOY=/var/www/html
DEV_DEPLOY=/var/www/dev

mkdir -p "$WORK_DIR"
cd "$WORK_DIR"

# Read all refs from stdin
while read oldrev newrev refname; do
    branch=$(echo "$refname" | sed 's|refs/heads/||')

    if [ "$branch" = "main" ]; then
        # Deploy main branch
        git --git-dir="$GIT_REPO" archive "$branch" | tar -x
        rm -rf "$MAIN_DEPLOY"/*
        cp -r . "$MAIN_DEPLOY"/ 2>/dev/null || true
        chmod -R 755 "$MAIN_DEPLOY"
    elif [ "$branch" = "dev" ]; then
        # Deploy dev branch
        git --git-dir="$GIT_REPO" archive "$branch" | tar -x
        rm -rf "$DEV_DEPLOY"/*
        cp -r . "$DEV_DEPLOY"/ 2>/dev/null || true
        chmod -R 755 "$DEV_DEPLOY"
    fi
done

# Cleanup
cd /
rm -rf "$WORK_DIR"

done

# Cleanup

# Deployment hook for main and dev branches

GIT_REPO=/git/project.git
WORK_DIR=/tmp/git-work-$$
MAIN_DEPLOY=/var/www/html
DEV_DEPLOY=/var/www/dev

mkdir -p "$WORK_DIR"
cd "$WORK_DIR"

# Read all refs from stdin
while read oldrev newrev refname; do
    branch=$(echo "$refname" | sed 's|refs/heads/||')

    if [ "$branch" = "main" ]; then
        # Deploy main branch
        git --git-dir="$GIT_REPO" --work-tree="$WORK_DIR/main" checkout -f "$branch"
        rm -rf "$MAIN_DEPLOY"/*
        cp -r "$WORK_DIR/main"/* "$MAIN_DEPLOY"/ 2>/dev/null || true
        chmod -R 755 "$MAIN_DEPLOY"
    elif [ "$branch" = "dev" ]; then
        # Deploy dev branch
        git --git-dir="$GIT_REPO" --work-tree="$WORK_DIR/dev" checkout -f "$branch"
        rm -rf "$DEV_DEPLOY"/*
        cp -r "$WORK_DIR/dev"/* "$DEV_DEPLOY"/ 2>/dev/null || true
        chmod -R 755 "$DEV_DEPLOY"
    fi
done

# Cleanup
cd /
rm -rf "$WORK_DIR"
